question: When should a skilled practitioner perform the prescribed ritual action?
premises: A skilled practitioner is the agent
The time is specified by solar course
inference: The skilled practitioner should perform it during the eastward or westward solar course.
uncertainties: Whether prāk-varuṇa-ayanam refers to specific solstitial periods or general directions is context-dependent
plain_english: The skilled one should perform it during the northern or southern course of the sun.
